info.title: CourseCI API
info.description: CourseCI backend API for the Vue SPA and Android application.

patch.description: Updates an active course owned by the authenticated teacher.

get.description: Available to the owning teacher and enrolled students, including for archived courses.

delete.description: Archives an owned course without deleting its history.

get.description: Teachers receive owned courses; students receive courses in which they are enrolled. Active courses are returned by default.
